name: CladisticsPro
description: A self-contained, browser-based platform for cladistic analysis of morphological characters, from the character matrix to the diagnosed cladogram (characters, homology and trees). It edits the matrix with character statements and state names, polymorphisms, missing and inapplicable data with dependencies, additive characters, step matrices, continuous characters and pictures of states and taxa; reads and writes NEXUS, xread, CSV and TSV; finds the most parsimonious trees by exact branch and bound or by Wagner addition with TBR, the parsimony ratchet, sectorial search, drifting and tree fusing, with constraints and in parallel Web Workers; weights characters by implied, extended implied and successive weighting with sensitivity to k; maps every change on its branch under ACCTRAN, DELTRAN or unambiguous optimization, with mouse editing of the cladogram; diagnoses characters (CI, RI, RC) and clades; measures absolute and relative Bremer support, bootstrap, jackknife, symmetric resampling and GC; summarizes trees by strict, majority-rule, extended majority-rule, semistrict, Adams and reduced consensus with wildcard taxa; tests hypotheses by their cost in steps with the Templeton, winning-sites and Kishino–Hasegawa tests; and writes a publication cladogram, figures, trees, a methods section in Spanish or English and a reproducible package. Every engine was checked against independent implementations in R and against the exhaustive enumeration of all trees.
softwareRequirements: A modern web browser; no installation
